item.title: North Shore high wind warning: Gusts up to 60 mph, power outage risk Friday
item.description: Strong wind gusts up to 60 mph are expected along the North Shore from Friday morning into Friday night, where a high wind warning is in effect. The rest of the Northland will see wind gusts over 50 mph. Power outages and snow squalls are possible in Lake and Cook Counties. The post North Shore high wind warning: Gusts up to 60 mph, power outage risk Friday appeared first on WDIO.com.
